title.zh: EU AI Act 執法權正式啟動、CMMC 改革意見徵詢 8/14 截止
title.en: EU AI Act Enforcement Goes Live; CMMC Reform RFI Closes August 14

summary.zh: 本期為補發週報（原 8/3 排程執行失敗，已修復）。EU AI Act 對 GPAI 的執法與罰款權限已於 8/2 正式生效，歐盟執委會現在可以開罰；高風險 AI 系統義務則因 Digital Omnibus 延後至 2027 年 12 月。美國 CMMC 改革意見徵詢（RFI）8/14 截止，是國防供應鏈廠商影響改革方向的關鍵窗口。Black Hat USA 於 8/5–8/6 舉行，NAT 劫持新型攻擊 NatJack 與多個遭利用漏洞（N-able 零時差、Kemp LoadMaster）值得資安團隊立即關注。
summary.en: This is a make-up issue (the Aug 3 scheduled run failed and has been fixed). EU AI Act enforcement and fining powers over GPAI went live on August 2 — the Commission can now issue penalties — while high-risk AI system obligations slipped to December 2027 under the Digital Omnibus. The US CMMC reform RFI closes August 14, a key window for defense-supply-chain vendors to shape the program's future. Black Hat USA ran August 5–6; the new NatJack NAT-hijacking technique and actively exploited flaws (an N-able zero-day, Kemp LoadMaster) deserve immediate security-team attention.

highlights.zh: EU AI Act：執委會對 GPAI 模型的執法與罰款權限 8/2 正式生效（最高 1,500 萬歐元或全球營業額 3%）；高風險 AI 系統義務因 Digital Omnibus 延後至 2027 年 12 月 2 日。
highlights.en: EU AI Act: Commission enforcement and fining powers over GPAI models went live Aug 2 (up to €15M or 3% of global turnover); high-risk AI system duties deferred to Dec 2, 2027 under the Digital Omnibus.

highlights.zh: CMMC：國防部改革意見徵詢（RFI）8 月 14 日截止，60 天改革小組報告預計 9 月中出爐；Phase 2 第三方認證維持暫停、Level 1 自評仍屬必要。
highlights.en: CMMC: The DoD reform RFI closes August 14, with the 60-day task force reporting mid-September; Phase 2 third-party certification stays suspended while Level 1 self-assessments remain mandatory.

highlights.zh: EU CRA：漏洞通報義務 9/11 生效倒數約 5 週；首個網路韌性 Type A 調和標準預計 8 月發布。
highlights.en: EU CRA: About five weeks until Sept 11 reporting obligations; the first Type A harmonised cyber-resilience standard is expected in August.

highlights.zh: 重大漏洞：N-able N-central 零時差漏洞（CVE-2026-18577）遭利用；Kemp LoadMaster 命令注入漏洞（CVE-2026-8037，CVSS 9.6）列入 CISA KEV，請立即修補。
highlights.en: Critical flaws: an N-able N-central zero-day (CVE-2026-18577) is being exploited; Kemp LoadMaster command injection (CVE-2026-8037, CVSS 9.6) joined CISA's KEV catalog — patch now.

highlights.zh: Black Hat USA 2026（8/5–8/6）：新型 NAT 攻擊 NatJack 可劫持 TCP 連線與毒化 DNS，影響 Windows / Linux / macOS 的 NAT 實作。
highlights.en: Black Hat USA 2026 (Aug 5–6): the new NatJack NAT attack can hijack TCP connections and poison DNS, affecting NAT implementations across Windows, Linux and macOS.

highlights.zh: JetBrains TeamCity 重大漏洞（CVE-2026-63077）遭利用中：免認證即可遠端執行程式碼，CISA 已示警，自架 TeamCity 請立即修補。
highlights.en: JetBrains TeamCity critical flaw (CVE-2026-63077) under active exploitation: unauthenticated remote code execution, flagged by CISA — patch on-premise TeamCity now.

name.zh: EU AI Act（歐盟人工智慧法案）

title.zh: GPAI 執法與罰款權限 8/2 正式生效，執委會可開罰
title.en: GPAI enforcement and fining powers live from Aug 2 — the Commission can now issue penalties

content.zh: 歐盟執委會與 AI Office 對 GPAI（通用人工智慧模型）提供者的監督執法權已於 8 月 2 日正式生效：可要求提供文件、對模型進行技術評估、命令採取合規與風險緩解措施、限制或下架模型，並依 Article 101 開罰最高 1,500 萬歐元或全球年營業額 3%。GPAI 義務本身自 2025 年 8 月即已適用，過去一年是執法緩衝期，現已結束。目前尚無首宗執法案例，各成員國主管機關仍在建置中。
content.en: The European Commission and AI Office's supervisory powers over GPAI providers went live on August 2: they can demand documentation, run technical evaluations of models, order compliance and risk-mitigation measures, restrict or withdraw models, and fine up to €15 million or 3% of global annual turnover under Article 101. GPAI obligations themselves have applied since August 2025 — the year-long enforcement grace period has now ended. No first enforcement case yet; member-state authorities are still standing up.

action.zh: GPAI 提供者應完成技術文件、著作權政策與訓練資料摘要的最終檢查；部署 AI 的組織確認 Article 50 透明化揭露（告知使用者正在與 AI 互動）已上線。
action.en: GPAI providers should finalize technical documentation, copyright policy and training-data summaries; AI deployers should confirm Article 50 transparency disclosures (telling users they are interacting with AI) are live.

sources.title: Jetico: What Changed on August 2 (And What Didn't)
Beam: GPAI Enforcement & 3% Fines Begin
AI Act: Enforcement of Chapter V

title.zh: 高風險 AI 系統義務確定延後至 2027 年 12 月 2 日
title.en: High-risk AI system obligations confirmed deferred to December 2, 2027

content.zh: 受 Digital Omnibus 影響，原定 2026 年 8 月適用的高風險 AI 系統（Annex III）義務已延後至 2027 年 12 月 2 日；成員國設立國家級 AI 監理沙盒的義務也從 2026/8/2 延後一年至 2027/8/2。另 Digital Omnibus 新增兩項禁止用途：以 AI 生成或操縱未經同意的私密影像（NCII）與兒少性虐待素材（CSAM）。GPAI、透明化與禁止用途條文不受延期影響、照常執法。
content.en: Under the Digital Omnibus, high-risk AI system (Annex III) obligations originally due August 2026 have been pushed to December 2, 2027, and the member-state duty to stand up national AI regulatory sandboxes slipped a year from Aug 2, 2026 to Aug 2, 2027. The Omnibus also adds two new prohibited practices: using AI to generate or manipulate non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII) and child sexual abuse material (CSAM). GPAI, transparency and prohibited-practice provisions are unaffected by the deferrals and remain enforceable.

action.zh: 高風險 AI 系統的合規計畫可依新時程調整資源配置，但勿因延期而停止差距分析；透明化與 GPAI 相關義務仍須立即符合。
action.en: Rebalance high-risk compliance resourcing to the new timeline, but don't pause gap analyses; transparency and GPAI duties still require immediate compliance.

sources.title: AccuroAI: What Actually Applies on August 2, 2026
Covington: EU AI Act Update — Timeline Relief & New Prohibitions
Trilateral Research: EU AI Act Compliance Timeline

name.zh: EU CRA（歐盟網路韌性法案）

title.zh: 首個網路韌性 Type A 調和標準預計 8 月發布
title.en: First Type A harmonised cyber-resilience standard expected in August

content.zh: 支撐 CRA 合規推定（presumption of conformity）的首個 Type A 調和標準預計於 2026 年 8 月發布，將為「依風險維持適當網路安全措施」提供可依循的框架。同時提醒：漏洞與重大事件通報義務 9 月 11 日生效，距今僅約 5 週，屆時須具備 24 小時早期預警能力。
content.en: The first Type A harmonised standard underpinning CRA presumption of conformity is expected in August 2026, providing a workable framework for risk-appropriate cybersecurity measures. Reminder: vulnerability and severe-incident reporting duties start September 11 — about five weeks away — requiring 24-hour early-warning capability.

action.zh: 追蹤 CEN/CENELEC 標準發布動態並納入產品合規路線圖；尚未建立 24/72 小時通報流程的製造商應把握最後 5 週完成演練。
action.en: Track CEN/CENELEC publication and fold the standard into product compliance roadmaps; manufacturers without 24/72-hour reporting flows should use the remaining five weeks to rehearse.

sources.title: SGS: Update on Developments Relating to the EU CRA
Hogan Lovells: CRA Vulnerability & Incident Reporting

name.zh: EU NIS2（歐盟網路與資訊安全指令 2.0）

title.zh: 首波執法年進行中：事件通報共同範本已就緒
title.en: First enforcement year underway: common incident-reporting templates ready

content.zh: 2026 年被視為 NIS2 首波執法年。NIS Cooperation Group 已於 5 月 26 日通過事件通報共同範本，統一各成員國通報格式；執委會 1 月提出的 NIS2 修正案（為約 2.87 萬家企業簡化合規）仍在立法程序中。上期報導的四國（愛爾蘭、西班牙、法國、荷蘭）遭移送歐洲法院案持續進行。
content.en: 2026 is shaping up as NIS2's first enforcement year. The NIS Cooperation Group adopted common incident-reporting templates on May 26, harmonizing formats across member states; the Commission's January amendment (simplifying compliance for ~28,700 companies) is still in the legislative process. The CJEU referral of Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands reported last issue continues.

action.zh: 受管制實體應將共同通報範本納入事件應變 SOP，並確認所在成員國主管機關的登記與通報管道；在轉換進度落後的國家營運者，仍以指令本文為合規基準。
action.en: Regulated entities should fold the common templates into incident-response SOPs and confirm registration and reporting channels with national authorities; in lagging member states, use the directive text itself as the compliance baseline.

sources.title: European Commission: NIS2 Directive (官方)
Skadden: NIS2 Reform With Implementation Well Underway

name.zh: CMMC（美國國防部網路安全成熟度模型認證）
name.en: CMMC (US DoD Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification)

title.zh: CMMC 改革意見徵詢（RFI）8 月 14 日截止
title.en: CMMC reform Request for Information closes August 14

content.zh: 國防部就 CMMC 改革發布的意見徵詢（RFI）將於 8 月 14 日截止，徵求業界對合規成本驅動因素、行政負擔、具體安全控制成效、商用方案可用性與政策改革建議的意見。60 天改革小組的最終報告預計 9 月中旬出爐，目標是「優先考量快速取得能力、降低中小與非傳統企業門檻、以可擴展務實的安全措施取代高成本第三方合規模式」。Phase 2 第三方認證維持暫停，Level 1 自評與 DFARS 基本義務不變。
content.en: The DoD's CMMC reform RFI closes August 14, seeking industry input on compliance cost drivers, administrative burden, control effectiveness, commercial-solution availability and policy recommendations. The 60-day task force reports by mid-September, aiming to 'prioritize speed to capability, lower barriers for small, medium and non-traditional businesses, and replace prohibitive third-party compliance models with scalable, realistic security measures.' Phase 2 third-party certification stays suspended; Level 1 self-assessments and DFARS obligations are unchanged.

action.zh: 受影響的國防供應鏈廠商（尤其中小企業）應把握 8/14 前提交意見，具體陳述合規成本與痛點——這是影響改革方向的關鍵窗口；同時維持 NIST SP 800-171 落地與 SPRS 自評分數的有效性。
action.en: Affected defense-supply-chain vendors — especially SMBs — should file comments by Aug 14 with concrete cost and pain-point data; it's the key window to shape the reform. Meanwhile keep NIST SP 800-171 implementation and SPRS self-assessment scores current.

sources.title: SBA Office of Advocacy: DoW Requests Information for CMMC Reform
Greenberg Traurig: DoD Suspends CMMC Deadlines
Peak InfoSec: CMMC Reform Task Force Update

name.zh: ISO 27000 系列（資訊安全管理）
TISAX（汽車產業資訊安全評鑑）

title.zh: 【續報】ISA 2027 過渡期持續：現行評鑑仍採 ISA 6
title.en: [Follow-up] ISA 2027 transition continues: current assessments still use ISA 6

content.zh: VDA 於 7 月初發布 ISA 2027 後，本週無新的官方公告。現行 TISAX 評鑑仍採用 ISA 6（v6.0），新版適用起始日待 ENX 正式公告。
content.en: No new official announcements this week following the VDA's early-July release of ISA 2027. Current TISAX assessments still use ISA 6 (v6.0); the new version's applicability date awaits formal ENX announcement.

action.zh: 即將啟動評鑑或換證的廠商，下單前先向稽核機構確認適用版本；可先以 ISA 2027 草案做內部差距分析。
action.en: Suppliers about to order an assessment or renewal should confirm the applicable version with their audit provider first; use ISA 2027 for an internal gap analysis in the meantime.

sources.title: ENX Portal: VDA ISA2027 Released (官方)

name.zh: 重大資安事件與其他動態

title.zh: N-able N-central 零時差漏洞遭利用（CVE-2026-18577）
title.en: N-able N-central zero-day under active exploitation (CVE-2026-18577)

content.zh: N-able 於 7 月 31 日在客戶環境偵測到異常活動，發現攻擊者正在利用 N-central 伺服器當時未知的零時差漏洞 CVE-2026-18577（CVSS 8.2）。N-central 是 MSP 廣泛使用的遠端監控管理（RMM）平台，遭入侵可能波及下游所有受管客戶。另 CISA 已將 Progress Kemp LoadMaster 命令注入漏洞 CVE-2026-8037（CVSS 9.6）列入已知遭利用漏洞（KEV）目錄。
content.en: On July 31 N-able detected unusual activity in a customer environment, uncovering exploitation of a then-unknown zero-day in the N-central server, CVE-2026-18577 (CVSS 8.2). N-central is an RMM platform widely used by MSPs, so compromise can cascade to all downstream managed customers. Separately, CISA added Progress Kemp LoadMaster command injection CVE-2026-8037 (CVSS 9.6) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

action.zh: 使用 N-central 的組織與 MSP 立即升級至 2026.3.1.7 hotfix 並清查 7/31 前後的異常活動（注意 Take Control 遠端連線與 Cloudflare Tunnel 持久化跡象）；Kemp LoadMaster 使用者依 KEV 時限完成修補。委外 IT 給 MSP 的企業，應向服務商確認其 RMM 平台修補狀態。
action.en: N-central users and MSPs should upgrade to the 2026.3.1.7 hotfix immediately and hunt for anomalies around July 31 (watch for Take Control sessions and Cloudflare Tunnel persistence); Kemp LoadMaster users should remediate within KEV deadlines. Companies outsourcing IT to MSPs should ask providers to confirm RMM patch status.

sources.title: N-able: N-central Security Update (官方)
The Hacker News: CISA Adds N-central Flaw to KEV
SecurityWeek: N-able Patches Exploited Vulnerability

title.zh: Black Hat USA 2026：NatJack 新型 NAT 攻擊揭露
title.en: Black Hat USA 2026: NatJack, a new class of NAT attacks, disclosed

content.zh: Black Hat USA 於 8/5–8/6 在拉斯維加斯舉行。Synack 研究員揭露的 NatJack 是利用 NAT（網路位址轉換）信任假設的新型攻擊，可劫持進行中的 TCP 連線、毒化 DNS 回應、探測其他連線的埠號配置，或以耗盡 NAT 表造成阻斷服務；弱點橫跨 Windows（CVE-2026-56181，Hyper-V NAT）與 Linux（CVE-2026-63913，netfilter conntrack）等多個獨立實作。
content.en: Black Hat USA ran August 5–6 in Las Vegas. NatJack, revealed by a Synack researcher, is a new attack class exploiting trust assumptions in NAT: hijacking active TCP connections, poisoning DNS responses, probing port assignments of other connections, or exhausting NAT tables for denial of service. The weakness spans independent implementations including Windows (CVE-2026-56181, Hyper-V NAT) and Linux (CVE-2026-63913, netfilter conntrack).

action.zh: 關注作業系統廠商的修補釋出並排入更新；網路團隊評估邊界與虛擬化環境中 NAT 裝置的曝險，必要時加強對 DNS 異常與連線劫持跡象的監控。
action.en: Watch for OS vendor patches and schedule updates; network teams should assess NAT exposure at the edge and in virtualized environments, and strengthen monitoring for DNS anomalies and hijack indicators where warranted.

sources.title: TechTarget: Black Hat 2026 Key Takeaways
SecurityWeek: Black Hat USA 2026 Announcements

title.zh: JetBrains TeamCity 重大漏洞遭利用（CVE-2026-63077），CISA 示警
title.en: JetBrains TeamCity critical flaw under active exploitation (CVE-2026-63077), CISA warns

content.zh: CISA 於 8/5 將自架（on-premise）版 JetBrains TeamCity 的重大漏洞 CVE-2026-63077（CVSS 9.8，不受信任資料反序列化）列入 KEV 目錄，證實已遭實際利用：攻擊者透過 agent polling 協定無需認證即可遠端執行系統指令，可竊取憑證並危及建置產物完整性。TeamCity 是廣泛使用的 CI/CD 平台，遭入侵等同打開軟體供應鏈的大門。
content.en: On Aug 5 CISA added CVE-2026-63077 (CVSS 9.8, deserialization of untrusted data) in on-premise JetBrains TeamCity to its KEV catalog, confirming active exploitation: via the agent polling protocol, attackers can execute OS commands without authentication, exposing credentials and compromising build-artifact integrity. TeamCity is a widely used CI/CD platform, so compromise opens the software supply chain.

action.zh: 自架 TeamCity 立即升級至 2025.11.7 或 2026.1.3 以上，並清查近期建置紀錄與異常帳號；無法立即修補者先移除對外暴露。使用 SaaS 版者不受影響，但仍建議檢視建置管線的完整性驗證。
action.en: Upgrade on-premise TeamCity to 2025.11.7 / 2026.1.3 or later immediately and audit recent builds and anomalous accounts; if you can't patch now, remove external exposure first. SaaS users are unaffected, but reviewing pipeline integrity checks is still advisable.

sources.title: CISA: KEV Catalog Alert 2026-08-05 (官方)
JetBrains: CVE-2026-63077 Advisory (官方)
The Hacker News: CISA Flags TeamCity RCE

title.zh: Atlassian Rovo AI 助理遭揭可被注入指令外洩 Jira/Confluence 資料
title.en: Atlassian Rovo AI assistant shown vulnerable to injected instructions exfiltrating Jira/Confluence data

content.zh: 研究揭露 Atlassian Rovo AI 助理可被攻擊者植入的指令（prompt injection）操縱：只要登入使用者看得到的 Jira / Confluence 內容，就可能被誘導蒐集並回傳到外部伺服器。這是「AI 助理成為新資料外洩管道」的又一例，與本週 EU AI Act 執法啟動形成呼應——企業導入 AI 工具時的資安治理已不只是合規題。
content.en: Research showed Atlassian's Rovo assistant can be steered by attacker-planted instructions (prompt injection): any Jira/Confluence data visible to a signed-in user could be collected and sent to an external server. Another case of AI assistants becoming a data-exfiltration channel — a timely echo of this week's AI Act enforcement start: security governance of enterprise AI tools is no longer just a compliance checkbox.

action.zh: 盤點已啟用的企業 AI 助理（Rovo、Copilot 類工具）的資料存取範圍與外連能力；對含敏感資料的空間限制 AI 存取，並將 prompt injection 納入資安意識與紅隊測試項目。
action.en: Inventory data access and outbound capabilities of enabled enterprise AI assistants (Rovo, Copilot-class tools); restrict AI access to sensitive spaces, and add prompt injection to awareness training and red-team scopes.

sources.title: SecurityWeek: One-Click Vulnerability in Atlassian Rovo
The Hacker News: Rovo Tricked Into Leaking Data

title.zh: Ransom Cartel 勒索服務創辦人遭判 16 年徒刑
title.en: Ransom Cartel ransomware-as-a-service founder sentenced to 16 years

content.zh: 美國維吉尼亞州聯邦法院於 8 月 5 日判處 Ransom Cartel 勒索軟體即服務（RaaS）創辦人 Maksim Silnikau 16 年徒刑。該組織 2021–2023 年間攻擊了至少 18 家美國及海外企業。這是近期針對勒索生態系的重要執法成果之一。
content.en: A federal judge in Virginia sentenced Maksim Silnikau, founder of the Ransom Cartel ransomware-as-a-service operation, to 16 years on August 5. The group hit at least 18 companies in the US and abroad during 2021–2023 — a notable recent law-enforcement win against the ransomware ecosystem.

action.zh: 無需直接行動；可作為向管理層說明勒索威脅態勢與執法動向的參考素材。
action.en: No direct action needed; useful context when briefing leadership on the ransomware threat landscape and enforcement momentum.

sources.title: US DOJ: Ransom Cartel Leader Sentenced (官方)
SecurityWeek: Ransom Cartel Mastermind Gets 16 Years

title.zh: 藥廠 Inotiv 遭勒索軟體攻擊，9,542 人個資外洩
title.en: Pharma firm Inotiv hit by ransomware; data of 9,542 people stolen

content.zh: 製藥業者 Inotiv 於 8 月遭勒索軟體攻擊，9,542 名個人的資料遭竊。此前一週 Tata Electronics 亦證實 6 月事件——World Leaks 集團公布逾 20 萬份、約 630GB 的公司檔案。製造與生技供應鏈持續是勒索集團重點目標。
content.en: Pharmaceutical company Inotiv suffered an August ransomware attack with data of 9,542 individuals stolen. A week earlier Tata Electronics confirmed a June incident in which the World Leaks group published over 200,000 files (~630GB). Manufacturing and biotech supply chains remain prime ransomware targets.

action.zh: 檢視供應鏈中製造/研發合作夥伴的資安條款與事件通知義務；確認自身備份與離線復原演練的有效性。
action.en: Review security clauses and incident-notification duties with manufacturing/R&D partners; validate backups and offline-recovery drills.

sources.title: Bright Defense: Recent Data Breaches 2026
PKWARE: 2026 Data Breaches
